intro.fr: Death Road to Canada se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Death Road to Canada can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Rocketcat Games sort Death Road to Canada en 2016.
text.en: Rocketcat Games releases Death Road to Canada in 2016.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub PixelShake92/DR2C-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Death Road to Canada.
text.en: The GitHub repository PixelShake92/DR2C-AP, home of the Death Road to Canada APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version Alpha_0.1, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version Alpha_0.1 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Death Road to Canada figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Death Road to Canada is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
